speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with left chest pain, a productive cough with purulent sputum, and shortness of breath. To begin our assessment, how would you describe the nature and duration of your chest pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of untreated influenza is concerning. Has the pain worsened, and do you notice any high fever or chills with the cough?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Left chest pain. I also have Productive cough with purulent sputum, Shortness of breath.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe)
